description: Add a file to a task or remove one. `action: "add"` fetches the given HTTPS `url`: the server downloads it, verifies its size and type, and stores it, so the model never sends file bytes. Pass a stable idempotency_key and reuse it for retries so a lost response cannot upload the file twice. `action: "remove"` deletes the named `attachment`. Read a task's files with task_show and `include: ["attachments"]`. Limited to 10 attachments per task and 10 MB per file. Allowed types: images (jpeg, png, gif, webp, heic), PDF, CSV, Markdown, and plain text.

action.description: Whether to attach a file or delete one

attachment.description: Attachment UUID or prefix (>= 4 chars). Required to remove

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."

filename.description: Display filename on an add; defaults to the URL's last path segment

idempotency_key.description: Stable key that makes retries safe: repeated calls with the same key create only one record and return the same id.

task.description: Workspace-scoped task number, encoded as a string

url.description: HTTPS URL of the file to attach. Required to add

workspace.description: Workspace id, slug, or name. Required when the account has more than one workspace: a call without it then fails and names the choices

name: attachment

attachment.description: The stored file on an add; null on a remove

title: Manage Task Attachment
